purpose: Golden window for the trend paper trader parity test (tests/test_trend_paper.py): the ENS, ENS_VT and BH_5050 records must reproduce the feasibility paper trader (paper.py) within 1e-9.
inputs: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT rows are the vendored ../spot1d_*.json rows up to the window end. eur_rows.json holds the BTCEUR, ETHEUR and EURUSDT daily rows [openTimeMs, open, high, low, close] of the window, from Binance public GET /api/v3/klines fetched 2026-10-03, with BTCEUR 2025-10-12, ETHEUR 2025-10-18 and EURUSDT 2025-10-20 removed on purpose so the EURUSDT fallback (and an unused missing EURUSDT day) are exercised.
outputs: paper_golden.json holds every record paper.py run() appended for the window (16 days x 12 books), started at the window start: date, book (paper.py's BH book is named BH_5050 here), equity and, per asset, the fields listed in asset_fields. paper.py rounds traded_notional, fee and vol30 to 6 decimals in its records; the test rounds those three the same way and compares every other number unrounded.
